main_text.l: autem familiæ, 1. جديلة Iadilah. 2. نبهان Nab-
han. 3. بولان Baulan. 4. سلامان Salaman, è
quibus بنو بكر Bohtarenses.
5. هني Hani. Ex his Aiyas f. Kabisa, qui
Noo-mano in regno successit. 6. سدوس Sodus,
cum Dhamma, atque ita à Saduso, altera tribu è
Rabia posteris, vel, ut Aljauharius, è Shaibani, distinguitur.
7. His accensentur بنو ثعل Banu Thosl, filii Tho-
ali, qui (inquit Aljauharius) Pater tribus inter
Tai-yenses, è quibus fuit عروبو المشيخ Amrus
Moshici filius, qui الناس ارمي Hominum sagittandi
Tribus etiam Taiyenfium nobilitavit حاتم Hate-
mus decantatæ inter Arabes liberalitatis Viri:
adco ut cum insignem beneficentia Virum denotare
velint dicant, أجود من حاتم Hatemo liberalior.
Quin & Madhejo oriundæ familiæ plures, è
quibus 1. خولان Chawlan. 2. جنب Ianb. 3.
اود Iud. [?] 4. بنو سعد Banu Saad: quorum pater
non antea mortuus est quam Viris ipso oriundis, qui
equitantem comitarentur trecentis stipatus
incederet, quos عشيرته i. e. cognatos suos appellavit
دفعا للعين ad oculi invidi fascinum
averten-dum. Unde ipsis in cognomen cessit سعد
العشيرة Saado'l Ashirah. Ex horum familiis
جعفي Ioffius, Ioffienses: & زبيد Zobaid. Zobaidicnses. 5. النخع Alnachaa, Nachaenses. 6. عنز Ans.
4 همدان Hamdan, Hamdanenses, Tribus sunt, &
ante & post Mohammedem celebris, لهم صيت في الجاهلية و الاسلام
5 Tribus 5ta, est كندة Cendah, ita eorum
Pa-ter cui nomen ثور Thaur, cognominatus est لاذ [?]

page.notes: Arabic words are copied as seen; ارمي and الناس are stacked over each other in the print, so their order is uncertain. "Hani", "Aiyas" and "Thosl" are doubtful and should be checked against the scan. The printed "fh" in "Mo-fhici" is read as "Moshici". Arabic words and the Arabic line at the bottom right are transcribed from the scan with doubtful letters; the Arabic order in "أجود من حاتم" and the word "لاذ" are uncertain. "5ta" is a superscript as printed. The number "2nd." after "3. اود" is unclear and is read as "Iud." with [?].
